sql: WITH t AS (SELECT split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) AS series, split_part(market_ticker,'-',1)||':'||split_part(market_ticker,'-',2) AS contest FROM paper_trades WHERE status = ANY(ARRAY['settled','closed_sl']) AND NOT coalesce(legacy,false) AND pnl IS NOT NULL AND quantity>0 AND strategy LIKE '%%mmsell%%' AND strategy NOT IN (SELECT twin_tag FROM live_paper_twins)), s AS (SELECT series, count(DISTINCT contest) AS contests FROM t GROUP BY 1) SELECT count(*) AS series_total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE contests>=300) AS ge300, count(*) FILTER (WHERE contests>=100) AS ge100, count(*) FILTER (WHERE contests>=50) AS ge50, count(*) FILTER (WHERE contests>=20) AS ge20, count(*) FILTER (WHERE contests<20) AS lt20, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY contests)) AS median, max(contests) AS max FROM s
